name: chain
description: The chain module (shruggr/skein#78, #79): the one writer of the instance's chain state — headers, transactions, proofs, spends, settlement, broadcasts — under chain/state; everyone else reads it by CID. Box chain: the host's events (header from its feeds, proof from its broadcaster: the `event` row, never a message), and {fn: ingest | status | proof, args} from the instance's own apps (the wallet, overlays: `$self`, by the host's loopback) and the owner; box chain/status (written status: a box is relative to the app, shruggr/skein#128): the status provider's messages (optional: left out on a host with none). Ingest a BEEF (shruggr/skein#121: the callers' rows name the filter beef, so the kernel's door hands ingest the pointer record's CID — the transactions and BUMPs blocks in the store, every BUMP checked against chain/state — never the bytes): proven, answered at once; unproven, recorded, broadcast, and answered on each state change (accepted, proven, rejected). docs/CHAIN.md.
